title: One rule, several targets
objective: Write a single rule for f1.o and f2.o and let $@ name the output of each run.
hint: When a rule lists several targets, make runs the recipe once per target with $@ set to that target. That is what lets the same recipe build both files.

steps.description: the recipe runs once per target
steps.stdout:
echo "building f1.o"
building f1.o
touch f1.o
echo "building f2.o"
building f2.o
touch f2.o

steps.description: the first target was written to disk
both files exist, so there is nothing left to do
steps.stdout: make: Nothing to be done for 'all'.
